## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to record the algorithm a signature was made with — rsa-sha256, ed25519 — so a verifier can assess its strength or compatibility.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for the signing key's own algorithm (that is [`gmeow:keyAlgorithm`](gmeow-keyAlgorithm.md) on the key) and for the verification outcome ([`gmeow:verificationStatus`](gmeow-verificationStatus.md)); this names the act's algorithm. It is functional — one per signature.

### How to use

- Attach the algorithm literal to the signature alongside [`gmeow:signingKey`](gmeow-signingKey.md); it complements rather than duplicates the key's [`gmeow:keyAlgorithm`](gmeow-keyAlgorithm.md), since a key may sign with different digest pairings.

### Examples

- ex:sig1 [`gmeow:signatureAlgorithm`](gmeow-signatureAlgorithm.md) "ed25519".
